findings: All four RGBA/BGRA graph pairs receive identical built-in cache filenames despite producing different pixels; separate SHA-256 namespaces contain distinct compiled blobs for those pairs. Clearing the cache does not prevent the collision.

The original graph is unchanged. An independent SHA-256 over normalized serialized graph structure, constants and runtime build identifies its cache directory. The provider still includes its own compilation-property key inside that directory.

The first expanded diagnostic continued after incorrect pixels and ended with process access violation 0xc0000005. The following uncached native suite passes without a physical restart; no device-loss error was reported.
Original v205 vertex-ID and blur failures persist with the OpenVINO cache disabled. The general bounds-mask correction is independently necessary.

The cache identity unit diagnostic checks known SHA-256 answers, constant permutation, stable generated names, input shape and binding-name changes, model immutability and IR round trips. The full integration qualification remains pending.

primary_sources.finding: ModelCache computes a model hash and adds compile configuration and runtime attributes.
The hash pass uses deterministic serialization and the constant writer data hash.
Documents separate driver and OpenVINO model caches. An explicit OpenVINO cache bypasses the driver cache.

integration_build_v208: Compile failure from Windows SDK macro leakage; no hardware checks or installation. The CNG implementation was subsequently isolated in a .cpp file for v209.
